method: 2026-10-31 cross-repository W0X rewrite. One record per row of this spec: action, decisions, retirement reason, new children, rows requested in other specs, cross edits requested of other rows, and harness consumer notes. Rules: one row standard, production caller chain, served proof, both sides declared, knobs, ecosystem boundaries.

new_rows_requested.title: Engine decision port for the coding loop
Bind the engine decision port at host start
Coding toolset is the caller of the changeset cycle

decisions: Entry point is meristem.graph.execute_graph because meristem.api does not exist on origin/main.
Capabilities are host-supplied facts; the harness verifies presence and version only.

cross_edits_requested.change: State that the harness stores the manifest through a blob-put port call before the commit and that the commit rides the DecisionLog commit op.

decisions: MEDULLA-DECISION-ENGINE-R135.7 carries the receipt on the later CompiledProgram commit, so the harness holds it until planning ends instead of submitting it earlier.

cross_edits_requested.change: Define the fields of RoundTaskOutcome (task_id, before_pass, after_pass) that R136.4 already references.

decisions: The harness reverts on unverified as well as falsified; only a verified verdict keeps an edit (fail closed).
Entry file moves from edit_engine.py (parser only) to a new edit_round.py.

cross_edits_requested.change: Depend on NEW:3 as the production caller of run_changeset_cycle.

decisions: Hook point is run_changeset_cycle, so the verifier runs for every submit.
